data.one_liner: Checks internet connectivity by sending a HEAD request to a target URL.
data.what_it_does: The package sends a HEAD request to a configurable URL (default Google) and reports whether the device can reach the internet at that moment. It provides a PingService with both a one‑off call and a stream subscription for continuous monitoring.
use_when: You need a lightweight way to verify internet reachability before making API calls
You want to monitor connectivity changes in real time without heavy dependencies
avoid_when: Precise latency measurement or low‑level ICMP ping is required
You need detailed network diagnostics beyond a simple HEAD request
strengths: Simple API with single method calls
Works on Android, iOS and macOS
Supports Swift Package Manager on iOS
weaknesses: Only performs a HEAD request, not a true ping
